summary.text: Mary Jo Durfee is the Democratic candidate for Idaho State Senate District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican Brent Reinke.
Her career experience includes working in accounting.

paragraphs.text: Mary Jo Durfee graduated from Jerome High School and attended the College of Southern Idaho.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up on a 250-acre farm outside Jerome, worked early in her career in education with special needs students, and is an income tax professional.
She listed year-round visas for migrant agricultural workers, the separation of church and state, and civil rights and access to representation for everyone as her key messages.
